create.name: Lizzie Lasater
create.bio:
Lizzie Lasater has taught yoga since 2005 and specialises in Restorative Yoga, which she also writes about. The daughter of the Restorative Yoga pioneer Judith Hanson Lasater, she grew up with the practice, studied at UCLA and Columbia, and now trains other teachers as a senior Relax and Renew trainer. Her teaching treats rest as a practice in its own right: few poses, plenty of props, little talking and long periods of stillness, so that students can turn their attention inwards, notice the breath and rediscover quiet. Much of her current work is for women in midlife and later, looking at how practice can change as the body does.

She lives in Salzburg, Austria, and teaches mostly online through the lasater.yoga school she runs with her mother, with self-paced intensives on Savasana, pranayama and embodied meditation, alongside a small number of in-person retreats and workshops in Europe and the United States. Every Sunday she sends a short newsletter on rest and ageing gracefully, and she offers free online Savasana classes. With her mother she co-wrote Savasana: The Practice of Radical Rest, published by Shambhala in November 2026, which presents the final resting pose as a complete practice.

books.title: Savasana: The Practice of Radical Rest
books.author: Judith Hanson Lasater, Lizzie Lasater
books.description: Co-written with her mother, the book argues that Savasana is a whole practice rather than the end of a class. It offers instructions and variations, illustrations, journaling prompts and the authors' own stories.

courses.title: Winter Reset: Embody & Inspire (Utrecht)
courses.description: A two-day in-person Restorative Yoga workshop at Yoga Moves in Utrecht, counting towards continuing education hours. Early-bird rates are offered.

courses.title: Living Your Yoga: A Retreat in Italy
courses.description: A week-long residential retreat in Salento, Puglia, taught by Lizzie with Judith Hanson Lasater. Booking is through the host.

courses.title: Yoga Summer Camp: Finding Connection and Creativity
courses.description: A week at the Feathered Pipe Ranch in Montana with Lizzie and Judith Hanson Lasater, joining yoga with creative practice. Currently taking a waiting list.
courses.price: $3295 (tuition and basic accommodation; wait list only)

courses.title: Savasana Intensive
courses.description: A self-paced online course in 25 lessons on Savasana and Restorative Yoga, moving attention from outside to inside. It can be bought alone or in a bundle with other courses.

courses.title: Pranayama Intensive
courses.description: A five-week self-paced course for building a home breath practice, with preparatory poses and lying pranayama, available for a year after enrolling.

courses.title: Meditation Intensive
courses.description: An online course with Judith Hanson Lasater and Lizzie on an embodied, daily meditation practice that uses the whole body as well as the mind.

courses.title: Restorative Teacher Training (50 Hour Certification)
courses.description: Training in the theory, sequencing and energetics of Restorative Yoga for teachers and serious students. Certification combines live workshop hours with a library of pose videos.
courses.price: USD $500 (plus tax) certification fee, in addition to the live workshop hours

free_resources.title: Savasana Summit
free_resources.description: Five days of free online reading, conversation and practice marking the launch of the Savasana book, with video lessons, guided practice and two live Zoom sessions on 12 and 16 December 2026.

free_resources.title: Rest for Real: Free Savasana Class
free_resources.description: A free online Restorative Yoga session offering a pause to rest body and mind; the Zoom link comes with her newsletter.
